name: starnet-observer
description: Standalone read-only local observer for Herdr, Codex, Claude Code, and llm-bus.

scripts.check: bun run check:static && bun run test && bun run dependency-isolation
scripts.check:root: bun run check:versions && bun run check:hygiene && bun run check:shell && bun run check:format && bun run check:helpers && bun run check:knip && bun run check:fallow
scripts.check:shell: uv tool run --from uv==0.13.1 uv tool run --from shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 shellcheck .githooks/pre-commit .githooks/pre-push tools/quality/check-static.sh tools/quality/check-versions.sh tools/quality/check.sh tools/quality/format-index.sh tools/quality/hooks.sh tools/quality/install-hooks.sh tools/quality/setup.sh
scripts.check:static: bun run check:root && bun run format-check && bun run build && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
